ai_prompt:
# Comments System Addon

## When to Use

Add threaded commenting to: blog posts, product pages, documentation, community content, events, portfolios.

## Quick Start

```jsx
<Comments databaseClass="comments" relId={post.id} relType="post" />
```

## Database

The addon auto-creates a `comments` collection with security rules. Framework auto-manages: `created_by`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`. No manual setup needed.

### Security Model
- **Read**: Public (only approved comments visible)
- **Create**: Authenticated users only
- **Update**: Owner only (edit own comments within 5-minute window)
- **Delete**: Owner or admin
- **Votes/Reports**: Handled via addon API routes with admin-level DB access (server-side validated)

### Auto-joined Fields
`autoJoinUsers: true` automatically joins user profile data to each comment via `created_by` field.

## Configuration Options

```jsx
<Comments
  databaseClass="comments"
  relId={item.id}
  relType="product"
  options={{
    maxDepth: 3,              // Max nesting level (default: 3)
    enableModeration: false,  // AI moderation (default: false)
    enableVoting: true,       // Upvote/downvote (default: false)
    enableReporting: true,    // Report abuse (default: true)
    commentsPerPage: 10,      // Pagination (default: 10)
    allowEditing: true,       // Can edit own comments (default: true)
    editTimeLimit: 300,       // Seconds allowed to edit (default: 300)
    sortOrder: 'newest'       // 'newest' | 'oldest' | 'votes' (default: 'newest')
  }}
/>
```

## Use Cases

### Blog Comments
```jsx
<Comments databaseClass="comments" relId={article.id} relType="blog-post" options={{ maxDepth: 2 }} />
```

### Product Reviews
```jsx
<Comments databaseClass="product_reviews" relId={product.id} relType="product" options={{ maxDepth: 1, enableVoting: true, sortOrder: 'votes' }} />
```

### Q&A
```jsx
<Comments databaseClass="doc_questions" relId={doc.id} relType="documentation" options={{ enableVoting: true, sortOrder: 'votes' }} />
```

## Authentication

- **Guests**: Read approved comments
- **Authenticated**: Post, edit own, vote, report
- **Admins**: Delete any comment

Uses `app.auth.requireLogin()` for inline auth prompts (no page redirects).

## API Routes

- `POST /api/addons/comments/submit` — Create/edit comment (rate-limited)
- `DELETE /api/addons/comments/submit?id=xxx` — Delete comment (owner or admin)
- `POST /api/addons/comments/vote` — Upvote/downvote
- `POST /api/addons/comments/report` — Report for moderation
- `POST /api/addons/comments/moderate` — AI moderation (admin)

## i18n

Built-in translations: English, Spanish. Auto-adapts to user locale.

## Best Practices

1. Use descriptive `relType` values
2. Limit `maxDepth` to 2 for mobile readability
3. Use separate `databaseClass` per content type
4. Enable moderation for public-facing sites
5. Enable voting for Q&A use cases
